first_order: warning that r/ScottPilgrim's sprite may overlap the logo despite attempted updates
text:
Hi guys! One of your members came over and asked us to spare you, so I'll repeat here what I told them:

"We were going to come over and ask for a compromise, but the unfortunate matter is that we have no control over most of the people working on the sprite. Most seem to be trying to overlap your logo, and despite our efforts to stop them by me updating this post/updating on the Discord, most people working on the sprite are not reading said updates. Really sorry about that, but if we end up breaking into yours know there's nothing we can do :c"

Really sorry about this, we were going to ask for a compromise but thought it would look really bad if we made one and most ignored it anyway because they were unaware of it. We've tried our best to stop people from advancing by updating everyone. The majority of the people working on the sprite have no way of getting our updates because they are not reading them. We mean no harm to you guys, and we're sorry if we do end up breaking in!
